title: set_dispute_details
description: Fill fields on the already-open dispute form as the customer explains what happened, one at a time across several turns. Set only the fields the customer has actually spoken to and leave the rest unset — a turn that establishes only the reason sets reason alone. Values entered here are a draft the customer will review. This never submits the dispute: there is deliberately no action that does.

reason.description: Why the customer is disputing the charge, mapped from their own words (e.g. 'I don't recognise it' -> not_recognized).

cardPossession.description: Whether the customer still physically holds the card, e.g. 'I still have my card' -> have_card.

authorized.description: Whether the customer authorised the charge. 'It was never authorised' -> false.

additionalDetails.description: Any free-text detail the customer volunteers that does not fit the structured fields. Never place card numbers, PINs, passwords or one-time codes here — this value is sent to a third-party AI system.
